purpose: Test whether a synthetic system can derive a transformation rule from examples and apply it to held-out inputs, outperforming exact-example lookup.

tasks.held_out_condition: test input grids are not present among training inputs; the transformation rule is the same across train and test examples

policies.reasoner: enumerate the registered rule family, retain rules consistent with all training pairs, then apply the uniquely identified rule to each held-out test input
policies.lookup: return the memorized output only when the exact test input appeared in training; otherwise output the registered default grid
policies.random: sample a registered rule uniformly and apply it to test input

metrics.primary: exact grid accuracy on held-out test inputs
metrics.secondary: fraction of tasks with all five held-out outputs correct

interpretation_rule: PASS establishes only the registered representation-transformation and held-out rule-application property. It does not establish general reasoning, intelligence, cognition, self-model, biological equivalence, or universality.
